scope: Direct study worker only; evidence is local numerical testing, not field accuracy or exhaustive combinations.

models.modeled: SPA at UTC interval midpoint; fixed delta_t=67 s and atmospheric refraction; altitude-derived pressure.
models.gap: No measured pressure, subinterval integration or historical delta_t correction.

models.modeled: Ideal single-axis geometry and optional slope-aware backtracking.
models.gap: No actuator, slew, stow, motor energy or verified terrain/layout.

models.modeled: Uniform infinite parallel sheds; Hay-Davies row irradiance; explicit front/rear thermal policy.
models.gap: No finite edge effects, spatial mismatch or nonhorizontal tracker axes with rows.

models.modeled: Hay-Davies isolated plane or optional Perez; row branch remains Hay-Davies.
models.gap: No diffuse horizon masking; not all sky models are interchangeable with rows.

models.modeled: ASHRAE or explicit physical glazing parameters; beam only per side.
models.gap: Diffuse IAM unity; no soiling-dependent glazing fit.

models.modeled: Unity or bounded SAPM polynomial with explicit coefficients and airmass domain.
models.gap: No extrapolation or site spectral measurements; polynomial is not a spectral simulator.

models.modeled: SAPM, Faiman, explicit PVsyst heat balance or aligned supplied cell temperatures.
models.gap: Steady state only; wind height and coefficient fit caller-declared; no dynamic thermal inertia.

models.modeled: PVWatts DC or uniform De Soto single diode with ideal static bounded MPPT.
models.gap: Single aggregate bus; no DC cable circuit, multiple independent MPPT, mismatch or bypass diodes.

models.modeled: One aggregate PVWatts or voltage-dependent Sandia inverter, clipping and standby accounting.
models.gap: No independent inverter blocks, transient controller or thermal derating.

models.modeled: Signed transformer losses, constant external auxiliary consumption and aligned availability.
models.gap: No AC cable circuit, power factor/loadflow, auxiliary schedule or protection design.

models.modeled: Explicit beam horizon profile and aligned albedo/soiling input schedules.
models.gap: Not dynamic soiling/snow prediction; no diffuse horizon or near-object mismatch.

models.modeled: Rectangular interval energy and UTC midpoint monthly allocation; constant export cap.
models.gap: No annualization, export schedule, measurement comparison, calibration or P50/P90.
